propositions: Review gates cannot distinguish clean execution from failed, cancelled, skipped, budget-shed, or resumed work in runner return values, causing plan-review failures to become empty successful checkpoints and code-review losses when later criteria raise.

A new discovery submodule must define immutable DiscoveryStagePlan/DiscoveryUnitPlan inputs and typed per-unit outcomes (success, resumed, skipped, shed, failed, cancelled) with an executor that handles dependency-aware scheduling, explicit budget shedding in deterministic order, and cancellation observation.

The versioned envelope must cover material, code/ref, effective-policy snapshot, prompt and contract, model/mode, topology, and dependencies; only success and content-identical resumed units commit as reusable checkpoints, while failed/cancelled/skipped/shed units remain missing.

Deterministic positive budget shedding in ascending dependency rank then unit id order must produce identical shed sets across runs; systemic failures and cancellation abort remaining work with exact completed-so-far accounting.

Stored trace serialization must contain normalized ids, outcomes, reason codes, usage, and lineage only—no raw prompts, ticket/context bodies, provider responses, or secrets—and public review result schemas remain unchanged.
